business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: INDO-MIM provides end-to-end solutions for manufacturing precision engineering components using MIM technology, including mold designing, tooling, finishing and assembly, and also leverages investment casting, precision machining, ceramic injection molding and metal 3D printing. It serves automotive, defence, medical, consumer and aerospace customers globally, manufacturing over 9,000 types of products in Fiscal 2026 across a dual-shore (India plus US/UK/Mexico) manufacturing footprint.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Triax Industries, LLC — Subsidiary (acquired): USA; 100% acquired in Fiscal 2021, investment casting for industrial/aerospace applications, purchase price USD 12.50 million
- Conway Marsh Garrett Technologies Limited — Subsidiary (acquired): UK; MIM products and 3D printing serving the European market, purchase price GBP 10.53 million
- Phoenix DeVentures II Inc. — Subsidiary (acquired): USA; medical device design and development, purchase price USD 15.80 million

- Indo-MIM Inc. — Subsidiary: USA
- INDO-MIM Mexico, S. de R.L. de C.V. — Subsidiary: Mexico
- Green Meadows Investments Ltd — Corporate Promoter: Mauritius
- Jagada Investments Limited — Promoter group entity: Mauritius

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Backward integrated, dual-shore manufacturing. The integrated manufacturing set-up includes the MIM manufacturing process and in-house secondary processes for MIM components. Vertically integrated finishing technologies include electroless nickel and trivalent chromium plating, vacuum and sealed quench heat-treating, precision grinding and CNC machining to micron tolerances. As part of its backward integration strategy the Company initiated the manufacturing of stainless-steel powder and is in the process of establishing a manufacturing facility for iron powder production. It also offers plastic injection and insert molding along with product assembly and integration services. Over 80 different alloying options as of March 31, 2026. As of March 31, 2026, deployed 436 robots and 476 IoT-enabled machines. Manufacturing facilities are fungible across product sectors, allowing production capacity to be adjusted based on industry demand.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Customer concentration - top 10 customers contributed 38.41%/38.94%/42.00% of revenue from operations in FY2026/FY2025/FY2024 respectively
- Customer arrangements are typically open/discreet purchase orders without binding volume commitments; customers provide only rolling forecasts or indicative schedules
- High repeat-customer revenue contribution - repeat customers contributed 91.60%/90.91%/93.76% of revenue from operations in FY2026/FY2025/FY2024

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Pursuing new product verticals via a joint venture (INDO Flex Precision Private Limited with AUFLEX Co. Ltd, South Korea) for foldable hinge modules
- Diversifying into engineering metal parts manufacturing via new subsidiary INDO-MIM Arms Components Private Limited (incorporated December 5, 2025)
- Continuing to leverage diversified manufacturing technologies (MIM, investment casting, precision machining, ceramic injection molding, metal 3D printing) to address evolving customer needs across sectors
- Maintaining global sales presence (sales offices in China, Germany, US and representatives across nine other countries) to grow the export-oriented customer base

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Global leadership in manufacturing precision engineering components using MIM technology - largest manufacturer globally with 6.8% market share of MIM revenue (Calendar Year 2025), held for the last six years
- Long-standing relationships with Indian and global OEM customers, with repeat customers accounting for 79.64%/74.57%/78.73% of customers served and over 90% of revenue in FY2026/FY2025/FY2024
- Diversified product portfolio serving automotive, defence, medical, consumer and aerospace industries, preventing customer/end-market concentration
- Diversified manufacturing technologies (MIM, investment casting, precision machining, ceramic injection molding, metal 3D printing) plus mold design and tooling expertise
- Dual-shore global manufacturing footprint (India, US, UK, Mexico) enabling economies of scale, local sourcing and supply-chain security for customers
- High barriers to entry in the industry - significant capital investment, technical/execution skill, and a 2-3 year OEM supplier qualification cycle

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Customer concentration — Top 10 customers contributed 38.41%/38.94%/42.00% of revenue from operations in FY2026/FY2025/FY2024; loss of a top customer could materially affect business and results of operations
- Non-binding customer commitments — Customer arrangements are typically open/discreet purchase orders without binding volume commitments; customers provide only rolling forecasts/indicative schedules, creating demand-visibility risk
- High overseas/export revenue concentration — Revenue from operations outside India was 77.20%/89.92%/88.26% of revenue from operations in FY2026/FY2025/FY2024, exposing the company to FX, geopolitical and trade-policy risk
- Reliance on Company-commissioned third-party industry data — Industry/market data (including the 6.8% market-share and largest-manufacturer claims) is drawn from the F&S Report, which was commissioned and paid for by the Company itself; reliance on it for investment decisions is subject to inherent risk
- Untraceable historical corporate records — Certain corporate records relating to the Company's 2001 name change, including allotments and transfers of Equity Shares in the past, are not traceable

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Utilise Fresh Issue net proceeds towards repayment/prepayment, in full or part, of certain outstanding borrowings of the Company.**
- **Set up INDO Flex Precision Private Limited, a JV with AUFLEX Co. Ltd, for specialised production and sale of foldable hinge modules in India and other locations.**
- **Produce 45 to 50 new tools per month, among the fastest in the MIM industry for new product introductions.**
- **Maintain position as the largest global manufacturer of MIM precision components with ~7% MIM revenue market share.**
- **May undertake a Pre-IPO Placement of up to INR 2,000 million (not exceeding 20% of the Fresh Issue), which would reduce the Fresh Issue accordingly.**
- **Net Proceeds of the Fresh Issue (Gross Proceeds ₹5,000 million) to be utilised for repayment/prepayment of outstanding borrowings and general corporate purposes.**
- **Setting up a joint venture, INDO Flex Precision Private Limited, with AUFLEX Co. Ltd (South Korea) to produce and sell foldable hinge modules in India and other locations.**
- **New subsidiary INDO-MIM Arms Components Private Limited incorporated to carry out manufacturing of engineering metal parts.**
- **Maintain global market leadership in MIM technology precision engineering components.**
- **Sustain the ability to produce 45 to 50 new tools per month, positioning the company among the fastest in the MIM industry for new product introductions.**
- **Top 10 customers' share of revenue from operations has been declining (42.00% in FY2024 to 38.41% in FY2026); management flags continued dependence on top customers as a risk to monitor.**
